Prototype demo: listening, the stem mixer, legal cards and sheet music work. Accounts, downloads, the separator and denoising run in the full server version.

Recordings archive 1918–1939

Polish interwar recordings – ready for creative work

Listen, check the legal status and download separate tracks. For free.

1918–1939 PL · EN · UA 0 zł

How it works

  1. Listen

    The restored original and separate tracks: vocal, rhythm, melody.

  2. Check the status

    Every work has a legal card: the creators' dates, the legal basis and sources.

  3. Download for free

    After a free login: MP3, FLAC, stems and sheet music, with a download receipt.

From the catalogue

Every recording has a legal card, downloadable tracks and a notation draft.

Fonoteka

An open archive of Polish recordings from 1918–1939 in the public domain.

Fonoteka is free and non-commercial. Public-domain materials are marked with the Public Domain Mark.
